name: labs/msuarezrodriguez__python-instrument-control
title: Lake Shore 336 temperature controller (QCoDeS VisaInstrument)
intro: Lake Shore 336 temperature controller (QCoDeS VisaInstrument), adapted from msuarezrodriguez/python-instrument-control. It reads `identity`, `temperature` and `sensor_units`; sets `setpoint`, `ramp_rate`, `ramp_enabled`, `heater_range` and 4 more; runs `heaters_off`. `heaters_off`: turn both heater outputs off (RANGE n,0 and OUTMODE n,0,0,0) and read the ranges and modes back; this is the safe-state action. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
